Loads with renaming, a diamond (util is initialized once), functions and
closures across modules, and globals of a module used by its functions.
-- main.star --
print("main start")
load("geo.star", "area", "Shape", unit = "UNIT")
load("util.star", "twice", "COUNTER")
load("geo.star", area2 = "area")
print(area(3), area2(2), unit, twice(4), COUNTER)
s = Shape(2, 5)
print(s.size(), area == area2, type(area))
def total(xs):
    return sum_all([area(x) for x in xs])
load("util.star", "sum_all")
print(total([1, 2, 3]))
-- geo.star --
load("util.star", "twice")
print("geo init")
UNIT = "cm2"
def area(r):
    return twice(r) * r
def Shape(w, h):
    def size():
        return "%d%s" % (w * h, UNIT)
    return struct(size = size)
-- util.star --
print("util init")
COUNTER = [1, 2]
def twice(x):
    return 2 * x
def sum_all(xs):
    t = 0
    for x in xs:
        t += x
    return t
